title: One Tiny Word (quiz-first)
voice_notes: Remix variant — cold-opens on a prompt before teaching. Reuses lesson-03-es audio. No new TTS.

segments.say: How would you say: it is normal?
That little word means is. Keep the S sound clean.
You already know words like normal, legal, and natural. So now put it together.
How would you say: it is legal?
How would you say: it is natural?
Es is also the same word for he is and she is.
segments.show:
he is
she is
it is

segments.say: Try this one: he is liberal.
He, she, it. Spanish does not care here. We just use es.

caption: Did you get it before the reveal? One word — es — covers he is, she is, it is. Drop your score below.
